job.title: Sales Engineer
job.description:
External Sales Representative – Motors & Drives

Brisbane & Queensland Region - Negotiable base dependant on experience, plus super, car allowance and bonuses.

A leading global manufacturer in motors, drives, and rotating equipment is expanding its Queensland sales team and seeking a motivated External Sales Representative. This role is central to succession planning, with long‑standing customer relationships ready to be handed over as senior team members transition toward retirement.

If you enjoy being out with customers, asking smart technical questions, and building a territory with autonomy, this opportunity will suit you well.

About the Role

You’ll manage an established portfolio of motor customers across Brisbane while actively developing new business with OEMs and industrial end‑users. The role is hands‑on, relationship‑driven, and suited to someone who enjoys credible technical conversations with engineers, consultants, and project stakeholders.

The position sits within a revenue‑focused sales structure, reporting directly to the State Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow an existing portfolio of motor customers across Brisbane and surrounding regions

  • Develop new business with OEMs in pumping, crushing, screening, oil & gas, and mining

  • Build long‑term relationships with end‑users including councils and water authorities

  • Conduct regular customer visits and territory planning

  • Provide technical product guidance across motors, drives, gearboxes, and rotating equipment

  • Drive revenue growth through proactive sales activity and territory expansion

What You Bring

  • Electrical trade qualification or engineering background (preferred)

  • Experience with rotating equipment — motors, drives, gearboxes

  • Strong technical curiosity and willingness to ask questions

  • Self‑sufficient sales approach with the ability to close deals independently

  • Comfortable working collaboratively with management and internal technical teams

The Offer

  • Negotiable base salary dependant on experience, plus superannuation, car allowance and bonuses

  • Clear succession pathway as senior team members transition to retirement

  • A stable, global brand with a strong footprint across Queensland

Apply Now

If you’re looking for a role with autonomy, technical depth, and long‑term customer relationships, this is an excellent opportunity. Apply now or reach out for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Tendering & Sales Support Engineer
job.description:
Technical Sales Support Engineer – Switchboards & Control Panels

Melbourne preferred | Brisbane considered
Negotiable base + Super + Vehicle (flexible for exceptional candidates)


A rapidly growing electrical and control‑panel manufacturer is seeking a technically strong professional to take ownership of tendering and technical sales support. This role is ideal for someone with hands‑on experience in MCCs, DBs, MSBs, and custom control panels who enjoys the commercial side of engineering and wants to step into a high‑impact position.
 

What You’ll Do

• Own the tendering and quoting process end‑to‑end 
• Review scopes, identify risks, and prepare accurate costings for MCCs, distribution boards, main switchboards, and control panels 
• Translate complex electrical and control‑panel requirements into clear, commercially sound proposals 
• Support sales activity with technical insight, accurate tender preparation, and practical build‑quality guidance 
• Help remove the bottleneck currently limiting sales growth by taking full ownership of inbound tendering 
 

What You Bring

• Trade background + engineering degree (ideal) 
• Hands‑on experience with switchboard or control‑panel assembly, wiring, testing, or commissioning
• Strong understanding of breakers, contactors, relays, PLCs, HMIs, drives, power distribution hardware, and control components  
• Ability to interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, single‑line diagrams, and identify scope gaps or compliance risks 
• Familiarity with relevant standards (e.g., AS/NZS 61439, wiring rules, segregation, fault ratings) 
• Commercial awareness and strong communication skills 
 

Why This Role Matters

• The business has doubled in size and continues to exceed targets 
• Your work directly enables further growth — this is a high‑impact role 
• You’ll work with a leadership team who value technical depth, practical experience, and autonomy 
• Salary flexibility for the right person 

If you’re a technically strong switchboard or control‑panel professional who enjoys commercial work and wants to make a measurable impact, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
Business Development Manager – NSW/ACT
Data, Fibre & Infrastructure Solutions

A national leader in data‑centre and structured‑cabling products is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to drive growth across the NSW/ACT region. This role suits a technically strong salesperson who enjoys winning new business and working closely with contractors and industry professionals.
About the Role
You’ll manage a large, high‑potential territory with thousands of existing and unmanaged accounts. The focus is on new business development, contractor engagement, and project‑based solution selling across fibre, cabinets, structured cabling, AV, security, and connectivity products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business and grow existing accounts
  • Engage Tier 1–3 contractors and technical stakeholders
  • Conduct regular customer visits and structured weekly call cycles
  • Identify project opportunities and manage the full sales cycle
  • Provide technical product discussions across fibre and structured cabling
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, and CRM updates
Skills & Experience
  • Strong fibre infrastructure background (external/plant fibre essential)
  • Knowledge of structured cabling and data‑centre hardware
  • Proven business development experience
  • Ability to engage contractors and technical decision makers
  • High energy, hunter mentality, and strong commercial acumen
What’s On Offer
  • Negotiable base salary dependant on experience, plus car allowance and uncapped commissions
  • High autonomy and strong internal support
  • Clear career progression opportunities

How to Apply
If you’re a technically credible BDM with fibre and structured‑cabling experience, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Vaughan Bradshaw at Bradshaw Consulting for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
Service Technician – NSW (Electrical / VSD Focus)

Wetherill Park | Negotiable base dependant on experience + vehicle + overtime

I’m recruiting a Service Technician for a global electrical motors, drives, gearbox's, power products and automation products manufacturer that is expanding its NSW service capability. This role suits a qualified electrician with strong hands‑on experience in variable speed drives, motors and fault‑finding, who enjoys a mix of field work, technical support and customer interaction.

About the Role

You’ll support customers, distributors and internal teams across NSW. The work is varied and includes:

  • On‑site commissioning, start‑ups and troubleshooting
  • Phone‑based technical support for drives, motors and related equipment
  • Warranty assessments, reporting and documentation
  • Spare parts interpretation and quotations
  • Training for internal staff and authorised service partners
  • Working closely with sales and product teams on applications and customer requirements

Right now the role is roughly 3–4 days in the office and 1 day in the field, with the intention to increase field time as the NSW service function grows.

What You’ll Need

  • Qualified electrician (or Engineers Australia‑recognised electrical engineer)
  • Strong experience with variable speed drives and/or soft starters
  • Confident electrical and mechanical fault‑finding skills
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and standards
  • Clear communicator with solid documentation and reporting capability
  • Comfortable delivering training to small or large groups
  • Valid driver’s licence, White Card and ability to obtain a passport

Nice to have:
Experience with BESS, wind, PLC/HMI programming or commissioning.

Travel & Work Environment

  • Occasional interstate and international travel for commissioning
  • Overtime available (time‑and‑a‑half / double time)
  • Company vehicle (take‑home ute)
  • Supportive team with a strong focus on work‑life balance and long‑term retention

How to Apply

If you’re an experienced electrician with strong VSD capability and you’re looking for a stable, long‑term role with variety and career advancement opportunities, I’d be keen to speak with you. Press 'Apply' to submit your resume or call Vaughan Bradshaw on the mobile number below for a quick, confidential discussion.

Mobile - 0408 772 534

job.title: Commercial Manager
job.description:
Commercial Manager Brisbane | Full‑time | Heavy Manufacturing

An established Australian manufacturer delivering complex, high‑value projects across the energy, infrastructure, and industrial sectors is seeking an experienced Commercial Manager to lead its commercial function and drive strong contractual and commercial outcomes across the business.

The Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you will oversee the full commercial lifecycle — from pre‑contract strategy and tender governance through to contract administration, performance management, and close‑out. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, project teams, and external stakeholders to safeguard commercial integrity and support successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead pre‑contract activities including bid strategy, tender reviews, risk assessment, and submission governance.
  • Negotiate terms and conditions with clients and subcontractors.
  • Manage the transition from tender award to project mobilisation.
  • Oversee a portfolio of complex, high‑value contracts and long‑term agreements.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, and quality requirements.
  • Identify risks, implement mitigation strategies, and resolve disputes.
  • Lead head contract compliance, including notices, claims, variations, EOTs, and remeasurements.
  • Provide commercial guidance and mentoring to project teams.
  • Prepare concise commercial reports for senior leadership.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of industry regulations, standards, and innovations.
  • Manage and develop a team of Contract Administrators.

About You

  • Ideally degree‑qualified in Law (commercial/contract focus) OR extensive commercial management experience in a heavy manufacturing environment.
  • Strong negotiator — calm, articulate, and solutions‑focused.
  • Experienced in managing complex contracts and high‑value project portfolios.
  • Able to work under pressure while maintaining clarity, professionalism, and sound judgement.
  • Enjoys contributing to a high‑performing, collaborative, family‑oriented culture.

What’s on Offer

  • A stable, long‑established Australian organisation with strong values.
  • A high‑impact role with direct influence on commercial outcomes.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture built on trust, teamwork, and long‑term relationships.

Ready to Apply?

If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career goals, please submit your application or reach out for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Lead Engineer
job.description:
Lead Engineer – Automation, Control & Telemetry

Step into a leadership role where your technical depth and project discipline genuinely shape outcomes. This position leads a tight-knit team of up to five engineers, driving high utilisation, strong delivery performance, and consistent technical excellence across a diverse project portfolio.

What You’ll Lead
• Automation, control, and telemetry projects for water and wastewater networks
• Industrial automation solutions for manufacturing, food & beverage
• Control systems and integration for ITS, mining, and heavy industry

What You’ll Own
• Guiding and developing a capable engineering team
• Ensuring projects are delivered on time, to specification, and with commercial awareness
• Maintaining high utilisation and effective resource planning
• Providing technical oversight across design, programming, commissioning, and integration
• Building strong relationships with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders

What You Bring
• Proven experience in automation, control systems, or telemetry engineering
• Confidence leading small teams and setting technical direction
• Strong organisational discipline and a commitment to quality delivery
• Ability to balance hands‑on engineering with leadership and project oversight

If you’re ready to lead a capable team and take ownership of meaningful automation and control projects across essential industries, this role offers the scope and impact you’re looking for.
